feature_name: Ensure after hooks always run in linter plugins
description: Implement a fix to guarantee that when a `before` hook is called in the `createOnce` API, its corresponding `after` hook will always execute, even when errors occur during AST visitation. This ensures plugin state tracking remains reliable across all linting scenarios.
functional_requirements: Wrap the entire linting process in a try/catch block to handle errors thrown during AST traversal
Ensure after hooks are called within the error handling logic so they execute regardless of rule failures
Maintain the invariant that if a before hook runs, its after hook will always run for the same file
Handle errors thrown at various stages: in before hooks, during AST visitation, and in after hooks themselves
Replace existing test fixtures with a comprehensive test that validates behavior across all error scenarios
